w2:textbox.label: Create Frame-based Modal Popup inside Tab

(First frameMode="wframe" tab)
1-1. Select the frameModal option for the openPopup() method. (“frame”, ‘parent’, “top”, TabControl ID)
1-2. Click the $p.openPopup() button inside the tab.
1-3. Confirm the popup's display scope based on the selected option.
  “frame”: Displays as a modal popup within the current frame.
  “parent”: Displays as a modal popup within the parent frame.
  “top”: Displays as a full-screen modal popup.
  TabControl ID: Displayed as a modal popup inside the TabControl. (In the example, the TabControl ID is obtained via $p.getFrame().getParentFrame().getParentFrame().id.)

(Second tab with frameMode="wframePreload")
2-1. Click each button to generate popups of PageFrame, WFrame, and IFrame types.
2-2. Confirm that the popup displays at the top (“top”) or within its parent frame (“frame”) based on the options.frameModal setting.
(See the Script tab for detailed script.)
